text:
Elaine (Marketing): Quick heads-up 1 planning to go live with the 'Optimize: Performance Playbook' blog next Wed at 10:00 AM PT. Need legal signoff and CEO quote by EOD Tue. Sharing draft below 

Samir (Product): Looks good. Please ensure we embed the latency/cost chart and have a one-paragraph callout on Dedicated vs Hosted differences. Also want one customer quote 1 Elaine can you confirm Atlas? :white_check_mark:

Nora (Legal): I'll review tonight. Avoid superlatives like 'industry-leading' unless substantiated. Recommend citing exact p95 numbers and add a short benchmarking footnote about models and infra used.

Mike (PR): Proposed press timeline: embargo 9:30 AM PT, blog live 10:00 AM PT, reporter brief at 8:45 AM PT. I'll DM the outreach list. Do we want an embargoed press kit (one-pager, hi-res images, quote bank)? :memo:

Elaine (Marketing): Draft social and blog intro (please comment inline):
```
Blog headline: Optimize: A practical playbook for cost-efficient, low-latency LLM inference
Teaser: We9re sharing design patterns, config recipes, and benchmark-backed numbers to help engineering teams get predictable latency and lower token costs.
CTA: Read the playbook -> https://redwood.ai/optimize-playbook
```

Samir (Product): Suggested Dedicated vs Hosted blurb: "Dedicated pools provide predictable throughput and isolation; Hosted offers fast onboarding and burst capacity 1 our tests show Dedicated p95 latency at 45ms (seq=256) while Hosted averages 52ms under similar load. See chart."

Nora (Legal): That9s fine if chart + footnote included. Footnote suggestion: "Results reflect our standard benchmark harness on x86 GPUs; models and quantization settings are listed in the appendix. Customer results may vary."

Mike (PR): Top-tier press list: The Verge, TechCrunch, Protocol, Wired, VentureBeat, Bloomberg Tech. I can add trade and regional outlets. Will prepare embargoed briefing email and the press kit.

Elaine (Marketing): I uploaded the press kit to /marketing/shared. Checklist: legal signoff (Nora), CEO quote (Samir), customer quote clearance (Elaine), chart + footnote (Samir), analytics/tracking (DevOps), schedule publish (PressOps Bot).

DevOps (Infra): Tracking snippet and UTM tags ready. Need the tracking ticket ID to wire into the blog template and confirmation of publish webhook endpoint.

PressOps Bot: Scheduled publish job created: channel=marketing/blog, publish_at=2026-04-01T17:00:00Z (10:00 AM PT), embargo_until=2026-04-01T16:30:00Z. Job ID: 98374.

Elaine (Marketing): Nora please drop a thumbs-up when legal is done. Mike share final press list here before EOD Tue. Samir confirm chart PNG & footnote by Monday AM. :pray:

Nora (Legal): Reviewing now. Will post comments by 18:00 PT.

Mike (PR): Sharing press list in 30. Preparing embargoed briefing.

Samir (Product): Chart uploaded to /marketing/assets/chart-v5.png. Footnote uploaded: "Benchmarking performed on our standard harness; models and quantization settings are detailed in the appendix."

Elaine (Marketing): Social cadence idea: 1) blog link on publish, 2) 4-tweet thread highlighting key callouts + chart image, 3) short CTO quote on LinkedIn. Mike can you write the tweets after publish?

Mike (PR): Yep. I'll post the tweet thread copy here on publish and coordinate the embargoed briefings.

PressOps Bot: Reminder 1 add analytics ID 1284 to the blog template and confirm publish webhook endpoint.

DevOps (Infra): Analytics ID 1284 wired. Publish webhook endpoint confirmed: https://hooks.redwood.ai/publish.

Elaine (Marketing): Final notes: avoid unproven claims, include the footnote, get legal signoff. Thanks everyone 1 flag blockers ASAP. :rocket:

PressOps Bot: Publish job 98374 will run unless canceled. React :thumbsup: to confirm readiness.
